svg.title: macOS · Settings · Libraries · Add a library from PicPlace (sheet, 460pt) · 760×680
svg.desc: Mirrors AddLibraryFromPicPlaceSheet (App/SettingsView.swift, macOS) raised by the Libraries card's Add Library from PicPlace… row over PicPlaceController.librariesNotOnThisDevice and addLibraryFromPicPlace(_:in:) — libraries plan §3.7 / stage C1 (2026-09-16; drawn from the code 2026-09-18, the door verified on the Mac bench). Title 'Add a library from PicPlace', prose 'A copy of the library is made here — its projects arrive as previews; originals download per project. LetsLapse relaunches on it.', the account's libraries no known library here is a copy of as radio rows (name · N projects · bytes on PicPlace; the first chosen on appear), a Place line — the default location, Choose… opens an NSOpenPanel; the app names the folder <host>/<username>/<name>/ inside it (L19) — a failure line in LL.levelOff, then Cancel · Add and Relaunch: StorageRoot.createFromPicPlace makes the folder with the server library's uuid and name as its identity and the binding pending its first pull, registers it, commits the root and relaunches; the pull runs at the next launch. The phone's door (../iOS/settings.libraries.add-from-picplace.portrait.svg) has no Place line and opens the library at once.

g.text: A copy of the library is made here — its projects arrive as previews;
originals download per project. LetsLapse relaunches on it.
